item.title: Tim Walz demands federal government 'pay for what they broke' after Homan
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz is demanding the federal government "pay for what they broke" after the Tom Homan announced it would draw down its immigration enforcement presence in Minnesota.

item.title: Vulnerable Dem senator slammed for requiring photo ID at rally, but not to vote
